text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Dortmund stood at 9.7 €/m², up 2.4 % year‑on‑year and 23.2 % over the past five years, placing the city 29th of the 37 most expensive markets. The inter‑quartile range runs from 8.4 €/m² to 11.19 €/m², and a 60 m² unit costs about 582 € per month.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2.1 % and listings staying on the market for an average of 33 days; 22 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 14.4 %, while asking rents sit roughly 50 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 6.45 €/m².

The model‑based forecast for the next 12 months expects median asking rents of 10.31 €/m², ranging between 10.02 €/m² and 10.52 €/m², a 6.2 % increase.
